eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus in this Shanghai temperature market centers on 27–29°C as the most probable daily maximum for August 13 because recent model guidance shows widespread cloud cover and scattered thundershowers that will limit solar insolation and promote evaporative cooling. Official extended forecasts highlight an overcast regime with daytime highs suppressed relative to typical August climatology near 31–32°C, keeping surface heating modest amid high humidity and light steering flow. The 41% implied probability on 28°C reflects this consensus across ensemble runs, while the 10.5% on 30°C and lower odds above 31°C account for the small chance of partial clearing or delayed rainfall allowing brief additional warming. Resolution will hinge on the official Shanghai observatory reading, with any last-minute shift in convective timing or cloud thickness able to move the outcome within the narrow 27–29°C band.

eventMetadata.context_description: Persistent high-pressure anticyclonic conditions over northern Italy are driving trader consensus toward 34–36°C for Milan’s August 13 maximum, with 35°C holding the highest implied probability at 52.5%. ECMWF and Italian Meteorological Service model runs indicate sunny skies and light easterly winds that promote strong daytime surface heating above the long-term August average of 29–30°C. Minor forecast spread stems from uncertainties in boundary-layer mixing and urban heat-island effects, which keep 34°C and 36°C as viable alternatives while outcomes above 37°C or below 33°C remain low-probability outliers. Latest official guidance shows no significant model shifts in the past 48 hours that would alter this tight clustering.

This market will resolve based on the highest temperature recorded in the 'Daily Observations' table on Weather Underground, not the figure displayed in the 'Day High & Low' summary section; in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Daily Observations table shall be the primary resolution source not the Day High & Low section.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 13 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/cn/zhengzhou/ZHCC.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent forecasts from agencies like the China Meteorological Administration indicate persistent cloud cover, passing showers, and overcast conditions over Zhengzhou on August 13, which limit solar insolation and promote evaporative cooling to moderate daytime highs. These factors explain the tight market clustering around 25°C (45.5% implied probability) and 26°C (37.5%), as models show limited warming potential compared to clearer summer baselines averaging near 30°C. Minor variations in precipitation timing or wind could shift outcomes between these bins, while lower probabilities for 24°C or below reflect residual uncertainty in model runs ahead of the day's final observations.
